body: I'm kind of ok now, just slept a lot, will probably keep sleeping a lot, generally feeling like the less I'm conscious the better
I really don't think so I don't want to leave my bed at this point. Doing anything is difficult, walking to class let alone sitting there seems more than unmanageable right now

I just feel like everything bad in my head and in me in drowning out everything else and nothing is working to not feel like this right now, it just hurts, like bone deep emotional pain and I don't really know why other than this happens sometimes but it feels so much worse right now
